## Checklist
- [ ] `uv run pytest` and `uv run ruff check .` pass locally
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] New client/capture paths are cited in `docs/client-config-paths.md` (no guessed paths)
- [ ] Agents still cannot write to the vault except via `inbox/`
- [ ] No secrets or personal data in code, tests or fixtures
- [ ] User-facing strings are bilingual where practical
